Screenshots.Caption: One building per Document Type, on an island per folder, with roads for allowed children, compositions, block targets and picker references.
Focus mode rebuilds the layout around one type and its neighbours, and the inspector reads out its properties, compositions, parents, children and block targets.
The findings drawer: unused types, dead ends, duplicate aliases, broken block configurations and more, each row selecting the type it is about.
The usage lens recolours the city by content count, published share, cultures, incoming references or unused.
The free camera stands a perspective camera on the isometric angle, to orbit and fly over the city.
The list view is the same schema as a sortable table, with no canvas in it.
